data: THE CONTROL OF RECORD (the founder's 'back to the start', the project's order 15 October 2026 10:4x UK), version 24 BASE: a compiled period programme with NO PER-HASH DRAW. Version 21's lane array (16 lanes x 32 registers, the Anvil-R rotating window of 16 words a lane, no scratchpad), classes (the integer quota QUOTA_INT, the ILP wiring a = k + 21, b = k + 9), keyed read every second step with the item index drawn 16 steps ahead (64 items, 16 KiB a hash), two attempts a warp (pair_log2 1 carried in the slot; the sequence is the period's, so the pair draw has no effect on the hash) and the lean fixed cost, with the per-hash draws removed: the 16 shapes and their FIXED ORDER are the period's (the shapes from the period seed as version 21's, the order a Fisher-Yates permutation by fchain over the period seed's word 7), entry e runs shape order[e] for 16 steps (8 entries at 128 steps: the first 8 of the order), the slot immediates, predicates (fchain(shape word 2, 4096 + e) a slot) and window offsets are the shape's. THE PERIOD SEED as F-141's chain form (period_blocks 64, the anchor at finality depth 64, chain 7358). The canonical bytes version 21's 88 at version 24.
varies_per_period: the 16 shapes (the class order of each, the immediates, the load bits, the window offsets), their fixed order, the predicates: everything the card compiles, once a period, compiled ahead during the previous period
varies_per_hash: the inputs alone: the init state (32 registers and the 16 window words a lane from BLAKE3(Forge/init || E || S) expanded by the fold chain) and the 64 keyed items read at the state's indices; no sequence, no addresses, no predicates, no operation drawn per hash
increments: the day's sweeps re-read as one field each from this control: fp_mode 6 with the per-hash sequence (version 21 k2-lean-p64: the sequence per hash or per pair), chain_select (the sequence and the reads from the previous entry's state), route (the operand lanes from the previous step's result), select-all (the operation per hash per step), tensor (version 23, the multiply class)

red_team_chip_row: pending: the security review prices the control (a fixed programme a period: the fabric wires it once a period, the chip's row the period's compile against the card's)
floating: integer-only as mode 6's; the floating counters read 0 on every set
